title: Bibliography of Napoleon
text:
Bibliography of Napoleon

For his life and a basic reading list see Napoleon I of France.

Such list is far from exhaustive, a French specialist of Napoleon, Jean Tulard, considered by his peers "the master of Napoleonic studies", estimating in 2014 that there are some 80 000 books written about him, a number which rises constantly. [1] Napoleon is among the most written-about figures in history; Jean Tulard noted that more books have been written about him than days have passed since his death. [2] [3]
